The instant appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 has been filed on behalf of the appellant seeking the following reliefs:
"It is, therefore, prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to set aside the impugned award dated 23.03.2024 passed by the Coutt of Sh. Shivaji Anand:
PO-MACT, Distt-North West, Rohini Courts, Delhi in MACP No.389/2021, Sh. Anil Kumar Vs. Sh. Rohit Kumar & Ors."

sentences.text: 1 Issue notice to the respondent no. 1 through all permissible modes on filing PF within a week.
This Court is of the considered view that the matter requires consideration.

Therefore, subject to the appellant's deposition of 100% of the compensation amount along with interest as per the judgment/award dated 23rd March, 2024 passed by learned Tribunal, before the Registrar General of this Court within a period of four weeks, the operation of the impugned judgment/award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The amount so deposited by the appellant shall be invested in an interest bearing FDR in an auto renewal mode.
List on 20th September, 2024 before Joint Registrar (Judicial) for completion of service and pleadings.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J JULY 15, 2024 rk/ryp
